title: Authorized Story Engine Gate

evidence.claim: Checkpoint 0067 passed the complete GitHub Actions workflow.

AuthorizedStoryBuilder projects facts from exact durable editorial records; auto-draft requires corroboration while human review may authorize grounded uncontested sub-auto-threshold support but never unsupported or conflicted facts.
Article drafting requires an explicit authorized fact projection and has no raw Fact Kernel fallback.
Both auto-draft and approved re-entry paths build the same fail-closed authorized projection before article generation.
Tests cover safe-fact projection, exact approval binding, contradiction non-override and stale-record failure.
Tests prove raw Fact Kernel statements cannot be drafted without authorization and that article content uses only the authorized projection.
Initial 0068 CI exposed legacy approval tests that treated human approval as sufficient even when no fact passed the new projection; policy and fixtures were refined without restoring raw drafting.
Approval regression coverage now distinguishes human-authorizable grounded/uncontested review facts from explicit contradiction, which remains fail-closed.
